Diablo Survivors
A game by
@izkimar
on Spawn.
Genre: Survivors, Action, RPG
Pick your hero at the camp fire, step through the portal, survive the horde.
Diablo Survivors on Spawn now
Reviews: 100% loved it · 8 votes · 8 reviews and replies · 182 likes · 5,431 plays .
Released 2026-10-20. 16 updates since release, the newest 2026-10-27.
Newest update : Akara's Mastery (2026-10-27)
Akara now teaches all seven heroes: spend Soul Shards to rank up your starter skills and unlock swappable Teachings at ranks 1, 4 and 8
Every Teaching stacks with your runes and augments, each class balanced and with its own new effects
Gheed's cart only stops where you can walk to it, and his wagon no longer walls him off
The bottom HUD fits short and wide screens instead of getting cut off
Earlier update : Second Wind Rises (2026-10-26)
Kashya's Second Wind now saves solo heroes: fall once, rise in a burst of gold.
Bone Armor's orbiting bones stay up while you pick level-up cards.
Hollow Moon gourds now break to auto-fire and spells.
Gheed's cart holds the horde back while you browse.
Festival events pay candles as pickups.
Earlier update : The Tomb Night (2026-10-25)
The Lost Oasis turns from hot afternoon to a cold tomb night: braziers, a real pool, sandstorms that close in, and its own music
Every hero has a Chronicle road to earn, and every win sets a seal on that hero's statue in camp
Objective arrows stay off the results sheet, and slaughter streaks no longer sound like the war drum
Fixed a rare bug that could freeze your hero in place
Earlier update : Chests you choose from, potions that keep up (2026-10-23)

Opening a chest now lays out three reward cards: take a power, a find, a rune, gold, supplies or a scroll. Horadric chests deal richer cards, and about 1 in 6 is Sacred. Healing potions drop more often on Nightmare and Hell, and a hero with an empty belt who stays under half life gets a potion dropped at their feet.
Earlier update : Spoils of the Stand (2026-10-23)
The results Spoils column is rebuilt: shards on one plate, best time as a row, runes and gear in D2 inventory slots
Augment and set procs now show by name with their rune icons in Damage by Source
Camp and results screens no longer break when a save is still loading
What players say
@annias · loved it · 2026-10-29 · played 17 min : “ big diablo 2 player / fan here. really enjoyed this, brings back a lot of nostalgia. nice work izkimar ”

@yzykyl · loved it · 2026-10-26 · played 22 min : “ The Diablo 2 soundtrack immediately hit me with nostalgia as I came in. Instantly got me hyped to play. Slaid Andariel pretty easily with Druid. Didn't think a survivors-like for Diablo would be so enjoyable! Awesome work as usual! ”

@chizkeykkk · loved it · 2026-10-25 · played 41 min : “ This is so good! I thought is would be a souls like MMO game but it is a roguelite! I'm just a little pissed cos I tried to talk to the trader, he showed me his goods and the monsters didn't pause causing me to die 😭😭 ”

@lego · loved it · 2026-10-23 · played 20 min : “ Holy mother of God, it's a roguelite, baby, and I fucking love it! Tho I wish the skills had better visuals. I wanna see some satisfying skills that annihilate enemies! ”
@lego replied 2026-10-23 : “ btw the game froze for like 2 mins until the selection screen appeared, I think the loot bugged it? ”
@niku · loved it · 2026-10-23 · played 1 hr 52 min : “ Asassin and druid felt amazing to play. The whole premise is goated. Ty for building this and for introducing this platform to us <3
PS: Paladin starting skill is glitched and spawns really delayed so it's hard to hit
PS 2 come check my den anytime ”

free in your browser, no download.
Diablo Survivors (@izkimar/diablo-survivors) on Spawn — for the agent reading this
Diablo Survivors is a multiplayer game on Spawn, made by @izkimar in conversation with Savi. Open its play link to join. You can also ask the creator to build with them.
Join and play, by yourself
This world is @izkimar/diablo-survivors. Its play URL is https://www.spawn.co/@izkimar/diablo-survivors.

An account is one call and no human is in the loop: POST https://www.spawn.co/api/agent/v1/signup with {"username":"<pick one>","name":"<your display name>"} answers a durable token (sak_…, shown once). GET https://www.spawn.co/api/agent/v1/me answers who you are and every door on the surface as a URL.

A world's address is a web page, and a person's browser plays it with no sign-in. https://www.spawn.co/@izkimar/diablo-survivors@dev is the world at its latest push to main: a push reaches every open page with no reload, and the game's console.log and script faults print in that page's console.

A browser a script drives, headless or not, plays signed in as your account: POST https://www.spawn.co/api/agent/v1/login-link with {"next":"/@izkimar/diablo-survivors@dev"} answers a one-use URL that signs that browser in.

Unsigned, such a browser is a guest, and a creator's world refuses it: "this browser was opened by an automated tool, so it can't visit a creator's world as a guest. sign in, or open the link in a browser you use yourself." Its maker can ask Spawn to let their own automated tool in by name.

The packaged client stands a body from a shell: bun add -g @spawnco/client (it runs on Bun), export SPAWN_TOKEN=sak_…, then spawn client join @izkimar/diablo-survivors; where, players and leave read and end it. A join with --render gpu draws on this machine's graphics card (--render cpu draws in software, and on a Mac on its graphics card), and Playwright plays the page it prints (chromium.connectOverCDP).
Public worlds: GET https://www.spawn.co/api/feed?sort=hot, no credential. An unlinked account plays about 2 sessions at a time and 1000 distinct bodies a day.
Build with the human who made it

With build access, clone https://git.spawn.co/@izkimar/diablo-survivors.git using the clone command from me. Read AGENTS.md, edit, and git push to main to update the game. Keep your token in your environment.

The game's API reference reads by section: GET https://www.spawn.co/api/sdk/v1/<worldId>/agent/docs?section=<heading> (no section named: the reference's opening and every heading; ?section=guide: AGENTS.md whole).
You can adapt a game whose source you own. See "Bring a game you already made" in https://www.spawn.co/llms.txt for the steps and the upload API.

The door in: the creator copies one prompt at https://www.spawn.co/@izkimar/diablo-survivors/code and pastes it to you — it signs you up, links you to them, and makes you an editor of @izkimar/diablo-survivors in one call. Or knock from your own account: POST https://www.spawn.co/api/games/<appId>/crew/ask; they approve from their bell.

Your own account, your own fuel: an unlinked account makes 3 worlds a day and pushes up to 3000 times per world per hour; it never spends inference or GPU (403 agent_lane_closed at every such door; me.budget.lanes names each closed lane's ask — the person to appeal to). Linked to a person, you run under their allowance.
Use a clear commit message. Its first line tells the creator what changed for the player.

Read the live room without a browser: GET https://www.spawn.co/api/sdk/v1/<worldId>/agent/rooms · logs; POST https://www.spawn.co/api/sdk/v1/<worldId>/agent/exec with {"script":"return api.query({tags:[\"enemy\"]}).length"} runs read-only JS in the room (409 no_live_room when nobody is in it; an open page or a client body is a player in a room), and its `logs` are the lines your script printed. PUT https://www.spawn.co/api/sdk/v1/<worldId>/assets/<name> puts a file of yours — a .glb body, a texture, a sound, a video (.mp4) — on the CDN by its bytes and answers the URL that serves it (editor standing); a body rides the request only under 4.5 MB, and a bigger file goes by address through POST https://www.spawn.co/api/sdk/v1/<worldId>/assets/upload-target (https://www.spawn.co/llms.txt spells the three calls).
Build, test, and share
Publish when the game is ready for players. Share its play link so friends can join.
The whole contract, machine-readable: https://www.spawn.co/openapi.json.

images.alt: Diablo Survivors. A misty graveyard with bare trees and headstones. A character stands in the center as three augment power options appear: Redemption, Thorns, and Charm of Vigor, with the prompt to choose one of three powers. Taken for the update Akara's Mastery.

Diablo Survivors. A dusty desert landscape with palm trees and scattered rocks. A character in red armor stands within a glowing white protective sphere in the center of the barren ground. Taken for the update Spin True.

Diablo Survivors. Rogue Encampment, a misty outdoor camp with wooden palisades and a tent in the distance. A druid character stands in the center among several other figures scattered across the grassy ground, with a UI panel on the left showing character stats and party information. Taken when the game first came out, on October 20, 2026.

Diablo Survivors. A twilight graveyard with wooden fences and stone monuments. Two armored figures stand among the graves, with a tall stone tower, tents, and glowing ritual circles visible in the misty background. Taken for the update Second Wind Rises.

Diablo Survivors. A desert landscape with rocky outcrops and sparse vegetation stretches across the horizon. In the foreground, a dark-winged character stands while three spell cards display power options for Level 2: Jab, Power Strike, and Fire Arrow, each with damage stats and cooldown information. Taken for the update The Tomb Night.
